title: The art of dance has taught me to be focused — Latifat
lineage: Latifat Adepeju Oguntade describes her father's work. This is family testimony about credits and NEK Video Links, with no claim by her to have observed the shoot.

passages.locator: Answer to Could you share how your journey as an artiste began?
passages.quote: written and directed by my dad- Hammed Adesola Oguntade, aka Hamlilo.
passages.note: She names Aje Ni Iya Mi and identifies NEK Video Links as the production company. She recounts her father's running a troupe for stage work.
